mod.description: The @TakaroIntegration server mod (one TakaroIntegration.pbo of Enforce Script), loaded with -serverMod=; it reports game events and runs Takaro's actions inside the server, and talks to the sidecar over loopback HTTP

sidecar.description: The Node.js sidecar on the same host: it holds the Takaro WebSocket and serves the mod's loopback HTTP API, because Enforce Script has HTTP but no WebSocket client
